text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Tuesday, Reuters has not verified them nor does it vouch for their accuracy.

- The process against the owner of the financial institution TAT from Bitola Sonja Nikolovska and Julijana Atanasov, director of the payment operations from Bitola, has been postponed indefinitely at the request of defence.
- Macedonian government will discuss on Wednesday how to compensate depositors of bankrupt TAT financial institution.
- Yugoslav and Macedonian expert groups from competent ministries discussed abolision of visas between the two states. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom ++389 91 201 196
